description: This is a PHP unit test class for testing the LDAP connection API in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base endpoint test case and utilizes mock objects to simulate LDAP services and responses, validating the LDAP connection and lookup functionalities.

classes.name: LDAPTestConnectionAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that tests the LDAP connection API within the OrangeHRM system, including setup, mocking LDAP services, and validating connection and lookup functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes LDAP server configuration before each test or skips tests if LDAP is not configured.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of LDAP connection by mocking LDAP services, setting up configurations, and verifying the response message structure.

methods.name: getEntryCollection
methods.description: Creates a mock EntryCollection object based on provided LDAP entries and lookup settings, used for simulating LDAP fetch results.

methods.name: getLDAPEntries
methods.description: Generates mock LDAP Entry objects for a given list of usernames.
